0_why_a_rebuild_is_admissible.verbatim:
The line between admissible and inadmissible is not WHETHER the object is rebuilt, but WHAT QUANTITY IT IS TUNED TOWARD.

  * Tuning the object until the PATCHING RESULTS improve is inadmissible: that is tuning toward the hypothesis.
  * Tuning the object until THE MODEL CAN RELIABLY PERFORM THE TASK is admissible. Clean accuracy is causally upstream, independently measured, and unrelated to any patching result. It is legitimate for the same reason the correct-only inclusion rule is legitimate.

And a positive control is SUPPOSED to be easy. Making the control tractable is not the same as making the hypothesis look good.

0_why_a_rebuild_is_admissible.the_quantity_it_is_not_tuned_toward: any patching result, of which none exists

OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.recorded_as: P-0c-2 determination: the rebuilt object is not established, and no patching was performed on it.
OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.verbatim: The rebuilt two-hop object failed one of its registered validity requirements. Either the model does not answer it above the accuracy floor of 0.80, which is the same floor its predecessor failed and which was not lowered; or the ablation probe did not clear the tightened drop floor of 0.640625, which would mean the object had been made easier by making it more retrievable. In either case the object does not serve as a known-positive selection set, and patching it would produce numbers about an object that lacks the property those numbers would be read as measuring. THIS IS THE SECOND AND FINAL OBJECT. There is no third: a further rebuild after seeing two failures would be tuning the object until something passed, which is the move this whole procedure exists to prevent. NOTHING IS CONCLUDED ABOUT REAL ITEMS, ABOUT THE J-LENS, ABOUT ANY MODEL, OR ABOUT T. This is a failure to build an instrument, not a finding about anything.
OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.required_next_action: stop and report; propose no third object, weaken no requirement, and proceed to no estimand work

OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.recorded_as: P-0c-2 determination: the rebuilt object is established as a known-positive selection set.
OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.verbatim: The model answers the rebuilt two-hop items at or above the registered accuracy floor of 0.80, and removing the first hop's input collapses accuracy to chance with a drop at least as large as the one its predecessor achieved. The intermediate is therefore known BY CONSTRUCTION and required BY THE TASK, and the object may serve as the selection set on which candidate estimands are compared. THIS IS A PROPERTY OF A CONSTRUCTED OBJECT AND NOTHING ELSE. It is not a result about real items, it is not a phenomenon-level positive control for any borrowed item set, and it licenses no claim about J-space, the J-lens, the paper, or T. A constructed object is a SELECTION SET, and success on a selection set is not success on an application set.
OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.what_it_licenses: the OD-022 destruction sweep over the closed four-candidate shortlist, and nothing else

NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.recorded_as: P-0c-2 determination: no candidate estimand survived the clean-run destruction sweep.
NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.verbatim: Every candidate on the shortlist returned a materially non-zero value under a purely destructive patch, computed from clean runs alone. Two natural families had already died this way before the shortlist was written. The measurement is therefore not attempted, because an estimand that moves under pure destruction cannot attribute the movement it reports. NO NEW CANDIDATE IS ADDED: the shortlist was closed before any object data existed, and extending it after seeing which members failed would be selecting the instrument that decides the question.
NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.required_next_action: stop and report; add no candidate and revise no selection rule
